from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
p.write_text('[{"step":1,"file":"src/server/ua_services_discovery_multicast.c","function":"filterServerRecord","line":144,"var":"serverCapabilityFilterSize/serverCapabilityFilter","code":"for(size_t i = 0; i < serverCapabilityFilterSize; i++) { for(size_t j = 0; j < current->serverOnNetwork.serverCapabilitiesSize; j++) if(!UA_String_equal(&serverCapabilityFilter[i], &current->serverOnNetwork.serverCapabilities[j])) return false; }","note":"Each requested capability is compared independently, but the function never checks whether the same filter string appears more than once; duplicate entries therefore do not add any new constraint."},{"step":2,"file":"src/server/ua_services_discovery_multicast.c","function":"Service_FindServersOnNetwork","line":183,"var":"request->serverCapabilityFilter","code":"if(!filterServerRecord(request->serverCapabilityFilterSize, request->serverCapabilityFilter, current)) continue;","note":"The unvalidated filter array from the client request is passed directly into the record filter, so a malformed or duplicated capability list controls which discovered servers are returned."},{"step":3,"file":"src/server/ua_services_discovery_multicast.c","function":"Service_FindServersOnNetwork","line":194,"var":"response->servers","code":"response->servers = (UA_ServerOnNetwork*)UA_malloc(sizeof(UA_ServerOnNetwork)*filteredCount);","note":"Matching records are copied into a heap-allocated response array; if duplicate filters let unintended records through, the service returns them to the client and exercises the vulnerable path."}]')
print('wrote trace')
PY
